row: WorkingNation is the leading non-profit solution-oriented media organization creating and distributing powerful stories solely focused on the nation’s current and future state of work.We are an eclectic mix of award-winning journalists and content producers, established workforce and labor experts, executives, and philanthropists. Our team members have a passion for human storytelling and an idealistic commitment to building a resilient workforce.We are mission-oriented, with the ability to innovate, adapt, and cover the ever-changing landscape of workforce development; we report on the solutions and the skills needed today and in the coming years.Media and journalism is our business. Workforce development is our passion
